product.description: Read, edit, convert and render PDF documents through the Aspose.PDF object model.

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Convert a PDF, or an HTML page the engine imports, to another format with the engine's call for it. An html output is one file: it holds its images, fonts and styles itself.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a document: the engine's new document, or a copy of a template saved in the output's format.

commands.name: edit
commands.description: Apply a batch of set, add, delete and do operations to a PDF; nothing is written when one fails.

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Extract a PDF's images, attachments, tables or form data into a directory with the engine's calls for them; the page text is read with 'aspose-cli pdf read --kind text'.

commands.name: merge
commands.description: Merge PDF inputs in order with the engine's PdfFileEditor.Concatenate.

commands.name: read
commands.description: Read a PDF's objects, each with every row of the object table, and its inventory.

commands.name: render
commands.description: Render one or more PDF pages.

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search the text of a PDF's pages with the engine's TextFragmentAbsorber; each hit names the page's text and gives the engine's rectangle of the match.

commands.name: sign
commands.description: Sign a PDF with a PKCS#7 signature through PdfFileSignature.Sign, and read the new signature back from the saved file.

commands.name: split
commands.description: Split a PDF by page ranges, each part a new document with Pages.Add of its pages; every part is written or none.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate a PDF against a PDF/A profile with Document.Validate; the result holds its return value and its log.

v3/pdf/convert-command.description: Convert a PDF, or an HTML page the engine imports, to another format with the engine's call for it. An html output is one file: it holds its images, fonts and styles itself.

options.name: --convert-error-action
options.description: What Document.Convert does with what the PDF/A profile does not allow, a member name of the engine's ConvertErrorAction, such as Delete or None. Required for a pdfa output.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Local font directory searched in addition to the system fonts; repeat for more.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output path; defaults to a sibling using the target extension.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --pages
options.description: Pages to process: 1-based numbers and ranges such as 1-3,7,9-, or all. Default: every page. Only with --to html or tiff.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the PDF. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the PDF.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the PDF from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --to
options.description: Target format. Default: the --out extension's format, except pdfa-1b, pdfa-2b, pdfa-3b, which only --to chooses. pdfa-1b, pdfa-2b, pdfa-3b write .pdf.

v3/pdf/convert-result.description: Result of pdf convert: the file the input was converted to.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: The written file; tiff holds the pages in one multi-page file.

pages.description: The page range converted, as --pages gave it; absent when every page was.

converted.description: What Document.Convert returned for a PDF/A output; absent for any other.

conversionLog.description: The log Document.Convert wrote for a PDF/A output, as the engine wrote it; absent for any other.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example ENCRYPTION_REMOVED: tell the user the output opens without a password). Omitted when empty.

pdfConvertOutput.description: A file a PDF was converted to: the output, or a file the engine wrote beside it.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

encrypted.description: true when the produced file is encrypted and opens only with its password; omitted when its format cannot carry a password.

v3/pdf/ops.title: Object table operations
v3/pdf/ops.description: An edit's operations, applied in order to the document in memory; when one fails, nothing is written. Each kind's definition lists its addresses and rows, each add's and action's the engine call it makes.

address.description: An object's address: 'document' for the document itself, otherwise segments and keys from the document down, such as each kind's x-addresses shows. read gives every object's address. A form that starts with {kind} continues an address of an object of that kind, one of the kind's own forms. <ordinal> is a position from 1, as the engine's collection counts it; <index> is a position from 0. In a key that is a name, a / is written \/ and a \ is written \\.

set.description: Sets rows of the object at an address, in the order written; each row sets one engine member.
The address of the object whose rows are set.

props.description: The rows to set, by name, each in its kind's form; the definition of the addressed object's kind lists its rows.

add.description: Makes one engine call that creates an object, then sets rows of the new object.

delete.description: Deletes the object at an address.
The address of the object to delete.

move.description: Moves the object at an address to a position among its siblings.
The address of the object to move.

to.description: The position to move to, the engine's, from 0.

do.description: Makes one engine call on the whole document.

isEncrypted.description: Document.IsEncrypted; the encrypt and decrypt actions change it.

permissions.description: Document.Permissions: the bits of the file's permissions as the engine gives them.

info.producer.description: Document.Info.Producer: the engine writes its own when it saves.

info.creationDate.description: Document.Info["CreationDate"]: the date as the file holds it, such as D:20260515093000+08'00'; null when the file holds none.

info.modDate.description: Document.Info["ModDate"]: the date as the file holds it; the engine writes its own when it saves.

taggedContent.description: The document's logical structure, Document.TaggedContent; read does not list it, --at taggedContent reads it. Reading it makes the engine change the document in memory (its title, its PDF format and, when saved, its XMP), so nothing else reads it.

rootElement.childElements.count.description: Document.TaggedContent.RootElement.ChildElements.Count: 0 for a document without a structure tree.

page.description: A page: Document.Pages[n], from 1, which is Page.Number.

text.description: The text of a page, as the engine extracts it; read lists it only when --kind names it, and search looks in it with the engine's TextFragmentAbsorber.
TextAbsorber.Text after Page.Accept(new TextAbsorber()): the engine's default extraction, TextExtractionOptions.FormattingMode Pure.

area.description: The text in an area of a page, keyed by the engine's Rectangle LLX,LLY,URX,URY in points; read does not list areas, --at reads one, and redact_area reports the one it redacted.

text.description: TextAbsorber.Text after Page.Accept(new TextAbsorber(new TextSearchOptions(rect))): the text the engine finds in the rectangle.

annotation.description: An annotation of a page: Page.Annotations[k], from 1, of any subtype, links and the widgets of form fields included. A widget is the field's control on the page; its value is the field's, at field/<name>.

fullName.description: Annotation.FullName: the full name of the field the widget belongs to. Only on WidgetAnnotation.

action.uri.description: ((GoToURIAction)LinkAnnotation.Action).URI; null for a link whose action is no GoToURIAction. Only on LinkAnnotation.

destinationPage.description: ExplicitDestination.PageNumber of LinkAnnotation.Destination, or of the GoToAction's Destination; null for a link that leads to no page of this document. Only on LinkAnnotation.

action.file.description: ((GoToRemoteAction)LinkAnnotation.Action).File.Name: the other document a link opens; null otherwise. Only on LinkAnnotation.

font.description: A font of a page's resources: Page.Resources.Fonts[k], from 1. Fonts used inside form XObjects are not among them.

layer.description: An optional content layer of a page: one of Page.Layers, by its Layer.Id.

bookmark.description: A bookmark, an outline item: Document.Outlines[i] or the parent bookmark's [i], from 1. The engine gives a new object each time, so a bookmark's position is counted along OutlineItemCollection.Prev.

destinationPage.description: ExplicitDestination.PageNumber of OutlineItemCollection.Destination, of the GoToAction it is, or of its Action's; null for a bookmark that leads to no page of this document.

field.description: A form field, by its full name: each terminal field of Document.Form, the same object as Form[fullName]; a node the engine gives as the untyped Field, which holds no value, is listed as the fields beneath it, so field/form.person.name is a field of a hierarchical form. A group of radio buttons is one field, RadioButtonField; each button, like each control of any field, is also an annotation of its page, of type Widget.

fieldType.description: The engine type of the field, such as TextBoxField or RadioButtonField.

pageIndex.description: Field.PageIndex: the page of its first control, from 1.

count.description: Field.Count: the controls the field holds as kids; 0 for a field that is its own one control.

options.description: ChoiceField.Options, from 1 in the engine's order. Only on ChoiceField.

selected.description: ChoiceField.Selected: the selected option's position, from 1; for a radio group the engine gives -1 when none is selected. Only on ChoiceField.

signature.exists.description: SignatureField.Signature != null: whether the field is signed. Only on SignatureField.

signature.reason.description: SignatureField.Signature.Reason; null for an unsigned field. Only on SignatureField.

signature.verify.description: SignatureField.Signature.Verify(): whether the engine verifies the signature over the bytes it signed. Only on SignatureField.

attachment.description: A file embedded in the document: Document.EmbeddedFiles[i], from 1, in the engine's order, which is the order of the keys of the document's name tree; adding or deleting one can change the positions of the others.

params.size.description: FileSpecification.Params.Size: the size the file records, in bytes; null when it records none.

pageLabel.description: The page label that starts at a page: Document.PageLabels.GetLabel(pageIndex), keyed by the engine's page index, from 0 (pageLabel/0 starts at page/1). The engine gives a copy, so a set takes it, sets the one member and writes it back with PageLabels.UpdateLabel(pageIndex, label).

info.description: An entry of the document information, Document.Info[key], whose key is no predefined one (DocumentInfo.IsPredefinedKey); the predefined ones are rows of the document.

xmp.description: An entry of the document's XMP metadata, Document.Metadata[key], such as dc:title.

add.page.description: Adds a page to a document: Document.Pages.Insert(pageNumber), a new empty page, or Pages.Insert(pageNumber, page), a copy of a page of this document; without pageNumber Pages.Add() or Pages.Add(page), at the end

pageNumber.description: The number, from 1, the new page has; the page there and those after it move one on. Not given, the page goes last.

page.description: A page of this document the new page is a copy of; not given, the new page is empty, of the engine's default size.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new page to set after the call, as #/$defs/page lists them.

add.link.description: Adds a annotation to a page: new LinkAnnotation(page, rect) { Action = new GoToURIAction(uri) }, then Page.Annotations.Add(link); it goes last among the page's annotations

in.description: The address of the page to add to.

rect.description: The link's rectangle, LLX,LLY,URX,URY in points.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new annotation to set after the call, as #/$defs/annotation lists them.

add.bookmark.description: Adds a bookmark to a document: new OutlineItemCollection(Document.Outlines) { Title = title, Destination = new GoToAction(page) }, without a Destination when page is not given, then Document.Outlines.Add(item); it goes last. Adds a bookmark to a bookmark: new OutlineItemCollection(Document.Outlines) { Title = title, Destination = new GoToAction(page) }, without a Destination when page is not given, then the parent's OutlineItemCollection.Add(item); it goes last.

page.description: The page the bookmark leads to, through new GoToAction(page).

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new bookmark to set after the call, as #/$defs/bookmark lists them.

add.attachment.description: Adds a attachment to a document: Document.EmbeddedFiles.Add(new FileSpecification(stream, name, description)): the engine writes name to both Name and UnicodeName, and keys the file by its name, or by the name and a number when the name is taken

file.description: The file to embed; its content is read under the command's input budget.

name.description: The name the file has in the document.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new attachment to set after the call, as #/$defs/attachment lists them.

add.pageLabel.description: Adds a pageLabel to a document: Document.PageLabels.UpdateLabel(pageIndex, new PageLabel()): a label of the engine's defaults that starts at the page, replacing one that starts there

pageIndex.description: The engine's index of the page the label starts at, from 0.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new pageLabel to set after the call, as #/$defs/pageLabel lists them.

add.info.description: Adds a info to a document: Document.Info.Add(key, value)

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new info to set after the call, as #/$defs/info lists them.

do.stamp_text.description: Page.AddStamp(new TextStamp(value) { … }) with the members given; the engine's defaults are no alignment, indents and margins 0, opacity 1, Helvetica 10 in black. The read-back is the page's text

page.description: The page the stamp goes on.

xIndent.description: Stamp.XIndent, in points from the page's left edge.

yIndent.description: Stamp.YIndent, in points from the page's bottom edge.

background.description: Stamp.Background: true puts the stamp behind the page's content.

textState.font.description: The font's name, set as TextState.Font = FontRepository.FindFont(name).

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.stamp_image.description: Page.AddStamp(new ImageStamp(stream) { … }) with the members given; the engine's default is the image's own size at the page's lower-left corner. The read-back is the page

page.description: The page the stamp goes on.

xIndent.description: Stamp.XIndent, in points from the page's left edge.

yIndent.description: Stamp.YIndent, in points from the page's bottom edge.

background.description: Stamp.Background: true puts the stamp behind the page's content.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.redact_area.description: Page.Annotations.Add(new RedactionAnnotation(page, rect) { … }), then RedactionAnnotation.Redact(): the engine removes what lies in the rectangle and draws the fill there; FillColor's default is black. The read-back is the text the engine now finds in the rectangle, page/<n>/area/<rect>

rect.description: The area to redact, LLX,LLY,URX,URY in points, such as a search hit's rect.

overlayText.description: RedactionAnnotation.OverlayText: text drawn over the area.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.flatten_form.description: Document.Form.Flatten(): every field's value becomes page content and the fields are gone

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.flatten_field.description: Field.Flatten(): the field's value becomes page content and the field is gone

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.resize_page.description: Page.Resize(new PageSize(width, height)): the engine scales the page's content to the new size. The read-back is the page

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.import_pages.description: Document.Pages.Insert(pageNumber, pages) with pages of another PDF, or Pages.Add(pages) at the end when pageNumber is not given; it returns how many pages the document then has

file.description: The PDF the pages come from; it may be the edited file itself, as it was before the edit.

pages.description: The numbers of the pages to import, from 1, in the order they go in.

pageNumber.description: The number, from 1, the first imported page has; not given, they go last.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the password the file opens with.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.clear_info.description: Document.Info.Clear(): every entry of the document information

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.clear_xmp.description: Document.Metadata.Clear(): every entry of the XMP metadata

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.encrypt.description: Document.Encrypt(userPassword, ownerPassword, permissions, cryptoAlgorithm), or the overload with usePdf20 when it is given; the output is saved, read back and reported with this encryption, so it is not given with --encrypt

userPasswordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the password the file opens with; not given, the user password is empty and the file opens without one.

ownerPasswordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the owner password, which lifts the permissions.

permissions.description: The members of the engine's Permissions the file grants without the owner password, combined; an empty list grants none.

usePdf20.description: The usePdf20 parameter of the overload that takes it.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.decrypt.description: Document.Decrypt(): the output is saved, read back and reported without encryption, so it is not given with --encrypt

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.optimize.description: Document.OptimizeResources(new OptimizationOptions { … }) with the members given; the engine's defaults are false for every switch, MaxResoultion 6000 and the images' encoding unchanged

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

v3/pdf/read-command.description: Read a PDF's objects, each with every row of the object table, and its inventory.

options.name: --at
options.description: The address of the object to read with everything below it, as read gives it in at. Default: the whole document.

options.name: --from
options.description: The address of the object the window starts at; a truncated read's window.next gives it.

options.name: --kind
options.description: List only objects of this kind, one the ops schema lists; repeat for several. Default: every kind. Objects of the kinds page, text, annotation, font, layer, bookmark, field are listed only when --kind names them; window.notListedUnlessNamed names those a read left out.

options.name: --max-objects
options.description: The most objects one window lists. Range: 1-10000.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the PDF. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the PDF.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the PDF from the first line of stdin.

v3/pdf/read-result.description: Result of pdf read: a window of the document's objects in document order, each with every row of the table it has, and the whole document's inventory.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and the option values that continue it.

inventory.description: How many objects of each kind of content the document holds: under read the kinds read lists, under notRead the others.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.PDF reported while it loaded the document, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example ENCRYPTION_REMOVED: tell the user the output opens without a password). Omitted when empty.

objects.description: The objects of the window, in document order, each with its address, kind and rows; last, since it grows with the document.

v3/pdf/render-command.description: Render one or more PDF pages.

options.name: --dpi
options.description: Raster resolution; refused for vector output such as svg. Range: 36-1200.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Local font directory searched in addition to the system fonts; repeat for more.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output path. Default: the input path with the image extension. Several pages write <stem>.<page>.<ext> beside it.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --pages
options.description: Pages to process: 1-based numbers and ranges such as 1-3,7,9-, or all. Default: every page; at most 20 per run.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the PDF. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the PDF.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the PDF from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --to
options.description: Image format. Default: the --out extension's format, else png.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: Each written image and the page it shows, in page order.

dpi.description: The resolution raster images were rendered at; absent for SVG.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example ENCRYPTION_REMOVED: tell the user the output opens without a password). Omitted when empty.

pdfPageOutput.description: One file a command wrote, and the page of the PDF it holds when it holds one.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

encrypted.description: true when the produced file is encrypted and opens only with its password; omitted when its format cannot carry a password.

page.description: The 1-based page the file holds or comes from; absent when it holds no single page, as a whole-document file does.

v3/pdf/search-command.description: Search the text of a PDF's pages with the engine's TextFragmentAbsorber; each hit names the page's text and gives the engine's rectangle of the match.

options.name: --case-sensitive
options.description: Match letter case exactly.

options.name: --max-hits
options.description: Maximum returned hits. Range: 1-10000.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the PDF. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the PDF.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the PDF from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --pattern
options.description: Text to find, or a regular expression with --regex.

options.name: --regex
options.description: Treat the pattern as a culture-invariant regular expression with a one-second budget.

options.name: --skip
options.description: Matches to pass over before the returned hits; a truncated search's window.next sets it.

v3/pdf/search-result.description: Result of pdf search: the matches the engine finds in the text of the document's pages.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and the option values that continue it.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.PDF reported while it loaded the document, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example ENCRYPTION_REMOVED: tell the user the output opens without a password). Omitted when empty.

hits.description: The hits in page order: the address of the page's text, the row, the matched text and the engine's rectangle of it; last, since it grows with the document.

v3/pdf/sign-command.description: Sign a PDF with a PKCS#7 signature through PdfFileSignature.Sign, and read the new signature back from the saved file.

options.name: --certificate
options.description: PKCS#12 certificate path (.pfx or .p12).

options.name: --certificate-password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the PKCS#12 certificate.

options.name: --certificate-password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the PKCS#12 certificate from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --contact
options.description: PKCS7.ContactInfo.

options.name: --font
options.description: SignatureCustomAppearance.FontFamilyName of a visible signature; not given, the engine's default appearance.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Local font directory searched in addition to the system fonts; repeat for more.

options.name: --location
options.description: PKCS7.Location.

options.name: --out
options.description: Signed PDF path. Default: <input>.signed.pdf.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --page
options.description: The page parameter of PdfFileSignature.Sign, from 1.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the input PDF. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the input PDF.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the input PDF from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --reason
options.description: PKCS7.Reason.

options.name: --rect
options.description: The rectangle of a visible signature, the engine's System.Drawing.Rectangle the call takes: x,y,width,height in whole points, x and y the lower-left corner in the page's user space. Required with --visible.

options.name: --visible
options.description: The visible parameter of PdfFileSignature.Sign: the signature has an appearance on the page. Takes --rect.

v3/pdf/sign-result.description: Result of pdf sign: the signature fields the saved file holds signed that the input did not.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

signatures.description: The signature fields the saved file holds signed that the input did not, read back from it.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example ENCRYPTION_REMOVED: tell the user the output opens without a password). Omitted when empty.

pdfSignatureInfo.description: A signature field the signing added, as the saved file holds it.

verify.description: What SignatureField.Signature.Verify() returns on the saved file.

v3/pdf/split-command.description: Split a PDF by page ranges, each part a new document with Pages.Add of its pages; every part is written or none.

options.name: --by
options.description: How to divide the document: one part per page, per --every N of them or per --groups group.

options.name: --encrypt
options.description: Password for every output PDF. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --encrypt-env.

options.name: --encrypt-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for every output PDF.

options.name: --encrypt-stdin
options.description: Read the password for every output PDF from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --every
options.description: Pages per part with --by pages. Default: 1.

options.name: --groups
options.description: A page group with --by pages, one part each; repeat for more, such as --groups 1-3 --groups 4-6.

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: Directory that receives the parts, named <stem>.<n>.pdf.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --pages
options.description: Pages to process: 1-based numbers and ranges such as 1-3,7,9-, or all. Default: every page. Only with --by pages.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the PDF. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the PDF.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the PDF from the first line of stdin.

v3/pdf/split-result.description: Result of pdf split, which writes every part or none.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: Each part written, in order; its number is the one in its file name.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example ENCRYPTION_REMOVED: tell the user the output opens without a password). Omitted when empty.

pdfPartOutput.description: The PDF written for one part of a split, and the pages of the source it holds.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

encrypted.description: true when the produced file is encrypted and opens only with its password; omitted when its format cannot carry a password.

pages.description: The source pages the part holds, as range text such as 1-3 or 1-3,7.

v3/pdf/validate-command.description: Validate a PDF against a PDF/A profile with Document.Validate; the result holds its return value and its log.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the PDF. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the PDF.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the PDF from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --profile
options.description: PDF/A profile to validate against.

v3/pdf/validate-result.description: Result of pdf validate: what Document.Validate returned for a PDF/A profile, and its log.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example ENCRYPTION_REMOVED: tell the user the output opens without a password). Omitted when empty.

log.description: The log Document.Validate wrote, as the engine wrote it; last, since it grows with the document.
